name: medflow-backend
description: MedFlow — hospital management system (NestJS microservices monorepo)
author: Anar Talibov

scripts.env:init: for f in .env.example apps/*/.env.example; do [ -f "${f%.example}" ] || cp "$f" "${f%.example}"; done
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n gateway,auth,staff,patient,appt,record,billing,file,notif -c auto "nest start api-gateway --watch" "nest start auth-service --watch" "nest start staff-service --watch" "nest start patient-service --watch" "nest start appointment-service --watch" "nest start medical-record-service --watch" "nest start billing-service --watch" "nest start file-service --watch" "nest start notification-history-service --watch"
scripts.build:all: for app in api-gateway auth-service staff-service patient-service appointment-service medical-record-service billing-service file-service notification-history-service; do nest build $app || exit 1; done
